classification.difficultyReason: Perform polynomial long division and use the resulting remainder to determine coefficients giving exact divisibility.

answer.worked:
The successive leading-term divisions give $x^3$, $-8x^2$, $35x$ and $-174$. The corresponding subtraction steps in long division are:
$$\begin{align*}(x^4-3x^3-5x^2+x-7)-x^3(x+5)&=-8x^3-5x^2+x-7\\(-8x^3-5x^2+x-7)-(-8x^2)(x+5)&=35x^2+x-7\\(35x^2+x-7)-35x(x+5)&=-174x-7\\(-174x-7)-(-174)(x+5)&=863.\end{align*}$$
Thus the quotient is $x^3-8x^2+35x-174$ and the remainder is $863$:
$$x^4-3x^3-5x^2+x-7=(x+5)(x^3-8x^2+35x-174)+863.$$

children.label: ii
children.prompt: Hence, find $a$ if $x^4-3x^3-5x^2+x+a$ is divisible by $x+5$.

answer.worked:
Changing the constant term from $-7$ to $a$ increases the remainder by $a+7$. Hence the new remainder is
$$\begin{align*}R(x)&=863+(a+7)\\R(x)&=a+870.\end{align*}$$
Divisibility requires zero remainder:
$$\begin{align*}a+870&=0\\a&=-870.\end{align*}$$

The successive leading-term divisions give $x^2$, $-3x$ and $-10$. The corresponding subtraction steps in long division are:
$$\begin{align*}(x^4-3x^3-5x^2+x-7)-x^2(x^2+5)&=-3x^3-10x^2+x-7\\(-3x^3-10x^2+x-7)-(-3x)(x^2+5)&=-10x^2+16x-7\\(-10x^2+16x-7)-(-10)(x^2+5)&=16x+43.\end{align*}$$
The remainder has degree less than $2$, so division is complete. Thus
$$x^4-3x^3-5x^2+x-7=(x^2+5)(x^2-3x-10)+16x+43.$$

children.label: ii
children.prompt: Hence, find $a$ and $b$ if $x^4-3x^3-5x^2+ax+b$ is divisible by $x^2+5$.

answer.worked:
Compared with part (i), the polynomial increases by $(a-1)x+(b+7)$. Its remainder is therefore
$$\begin{align*}R(x)&=16x+43+(a-1)x+(b+7)\\R(x)&=(a+15)x+(b+50).\end{align*}$$
For divisibility, both coefficients of the remainder must be zero:
$$\begin{align*}a+15&=0\\a&=-15\\b+50&=0\\b&=-50.\end{align*}$$
